topologyAssessment.method: Trimesh 4.0.5; GLB loaded with process=False and force=scene, scene.dump(concatenate=True). Face adjacency components include all face indices. Unique edge incidence counts identify boundary (1) and non-manifold (>2) edges. Zero-area means area_faces == 0. No geometry repair or welding applied.
topologyAssessment.scope: Diagnostics, not character or rig approval. Disconnected components and open boundaries are not by themselves a prohibition on skinning.
